A '''star system''' was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Corva sector/Legends|Corva sector]]. One of the more remote [[Star system/Legends|systems]] in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]], it contained a [[Unidentified Corva sector planet|terrestrial planet]] on which the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] maintained the hidden [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] base known as [[Titan Base]]. The Alliance kept the system location of Titan Base classified even from Rebel agents brought there from elsewhere.<ref name="OSG" />
